name: unifictional-platform
description: One repo for everything Unifictional ships: the marketing site + AI site builder, the Client Portal (SEO Autopilot), and the 3D Remodel Studio. Each app keeps its own package.json; these scripts just reach into them.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix unifictional-site install && npm --prefix "Client Portal" install && npm --prefix "3D Studio" install
scripts.lint: npm --prefix unifictional-site run lint && npm --prefix "Client Portal" run lint && npm --prefix "3D Studio" run lint
